measurements.note: Render timing includes synchronous one-pixel readback to drain the GPU command queue and browser round-trip overhead; not pure GPU time. Frame intervals are requestAnimationFrame gaps in this synthetic loop, not a hardware-device FPS guarantee.

limitations: Linux Chromium SwiftShader software rendering. Synchronous readback loop and warm caches; not real-phone FPS, hardware GPU time, heap leak proof or a 30fps guarantee. Camera is fixed. Shadow refresh on every frame is not measured.
memoryMethod: Separate fresh browser. Two warm-up round trips, six measured round trips. One animation-frame boundary and synchronous renderer/readback fence after each import; counts sampled after drawing. Initial asynchronous samples retained separately.
